If the Workspace Trust dialog appears: click 'Yes, I trust the authors'
If line 80 is not visible (it should be centred), click 'departments' in the breadcrumb bar's symbol list to reveal it; move the pointer off the window
steps: Click Terminal > Run Task..., then 'node src/ts/main.ts samples/requests.json': the panel prints the digest
Hold about 4 seconds, then click Terminal > Run Task..., then 'npx tsc -p tsconfig.json': nothing from the compiler, then 0 (its exit code)
Hold about 4 seconds with Map.groupBy and the digest both visible; move the pointer off the window; create recordings\stop
After the take: click the window's close button (X)
